page.overview:
Who is Achmed Korba?

Achmed then traveled to the US with Sha Shan and, in a short time, opened a restaurant in New York. From there, he promoted the Legion of Light as a peace-loving organization and began amounting followers, but its true purpose was to gather people who could then be manipulated as pawns of the Man-Beast.

The Man-Beast was eventually defeated by Spider Man and Flash Thompson, and Sha Shan was freed from the mission imposed by her father, as Achmed died in an explosion.
